title: The Trinidad and Tobago Postal Corporation (Amendment) Act, 2004
text:
Legal Supplement Part Ato the “Trinidad and Tobago Gazette’’, Vol. 43,
No. 70, 29th April, 2004
Second Session Eighth Parliament Republic of
Trinidad and Tobago
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
Act No. 13 of 2004
[L.S.]
AN ACT to amend the Trinidad and Tobago Postal
Corporation Act, No. 1 of 1999 to extend the period
of exemption from taxes and other charges
[Assented to 28th April, 2004]
ENACTED by the Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago as
Enactment
follows:—
l. This Act may be cited as the Trinidad and
Short title
Tobago Postal Corporation (Amendment) Act, 2004.

246 No. 13 Trinidad and Tobago Postal Corporation 2004
(Amendment)
Section 34 amended 2. Section 34 of the Trinidad and Tobago Postal
No. 1 of 1999
Corporation Act is amended in subsection (1) by
deleting the words “for a period of three years from
the commencement of this section,” and substituting
the words “from the 10th day of February, 1999 to the
30th day of June, 2004,”.
Passed in the House of Representatives this 7th day
of November, 2003.
J. SAMPSON-JACENT
Clerk of the House
Passed in the Senate this 20th day of April, 2004.
D. DOLLY
Clerk of the Senate
PRINTED BY THE GOVERNMENT PRINTER, PORT-OF-SPAIN
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO—2004
